mercimek çorbası.name: Mercimek Çorbası (Red Lentil Soup)
mercimek çorbası.recipe: Sauté onion in butter, add flour, then lentils, carrot, potato and water. Boil 30 min, blend, season with salt and cumin.

kuru fasulye.name: Kuru Fasulye (White Bean Stew)
kuru fasulye.recipe: Soak beans overnight. Sauté onion in oil, add tomato paste, beans and water. Simmer 60–90 min until soft.

pirinç pilavı.name: Pirinç Pilavı (Rice Pilaf)
pirinç pilavı.recipe: Brown orzo in butter, add washed rice, stir, add hot water and salt. Cook on low heat 15 min, rest 10 min.
